description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, adding {1}.
Bone Miser triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, triggering Ovalchase Daredevil, causing you to return it to your hand from the graveyard.
Repeat.
